records.title: On the Width Scaling of Neural Optimizers Under Matrix Operator Norms I: Row/Column Normalization and Hyperparameter Transfer
records.reason: The paper studies width scaling and normalization of neural optimizers during training, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Tuning-Free Long Video Generation via Global-Local Collaborative Diffusion
records.reason: Global-local diffusion targets long-video coherence and generation of longer videos, but the reviewed text does not provide a concrete inference-cost/latency optimization despite lineage relevance.

records.title: SiameseNorm: Breaking the Barrier to Reconciling Pre/Post-Norm
records.reason: SiameseNorm studies pre/post-normalization architecture and training stability, not inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Inverse Depth Scaling From Most Layers Being Similar
records.reason: Inverse depth scaling is a model/training scaling observation, not a concrete LLM inference or serving optimization.

records.title: Optimal Software Pipelining and Warp Specialization for Tensor Core GPUs
records.reason: Twill optimizes software pipelining and warp specialization for tensor-core kernels; its evidence is generic kernel scheduling rather than a direct LLM inference/serving evaluation.
